## 📅 Study Planner Pipeline

**Webhook:** `POST /webhook/learnify-study-planner`

**Request body:**
```json
{ "studentId": "...", "noteId": "...", "userId": "...",
  "subject": "Physics", "topic": "Waves",
  "examDate": "2026-11-01", "availableHoursPerDay": 2,
  "extractedText": "..." }
```

**RAG is automatically applied** — curriculum context fetched from backend.

**Env vars needed:**
- `GOOGLE_PALM_API` credential
- `backendUrl` in Set Config node

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'models/text-embedding-004', content: { parts: [{ text: (($('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json).subject || '') + ' ' + (($('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json).topic || '') + ' exam preparation study plan' }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ embedding: $json.embedding?.values || [], limit: 5, subject: ($('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json).subject, topic:   ($('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json).topic, curriculumType: ($('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Study Planner').item.json).curriculumType || 'WAEC' }) }}
